name: trait Allocator
rule: A memory block currently allocated by an allocator may be passed to any method of that allocator that accepts such an argument. A block is currently allocated when its starting address was previously returned by allocate, grow, or shrink and it has not subsequently been deallocated; deallocate and successful grow or shrink calls deallocate the block, while grow or shrink calls returning Err do not.
expression: Not expressible in the supplied DSL: only opaque `Self` metadata is available, with no block, allocator instance, or allocation-history observations.
